name: The Lantern Road
tagline: A dark crossing. A road into the missing villages.
description: Lead Captain Nera’s patrol across a river whose far bank has gone dark. Find the ferryman, reopen the village road, and follow the people taken by the dead.
shortDescription: Investigate the dark eastern bank and follow the missing villagers.

ending.speaker: Nera
ending.text: Leave a watch at every crossing. Carry lamps down the road. We opened the valley; now we keep it open.
